title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
slides: Why would Trump tax companies for building abroad?
He says AI data centers must stay in America
Yet US power grids can't handle the demand
Your AI bill may rise regardless of location
Watch where the next data center breaks ground
thread_text:
1. The AI Power Gamble

Trump says data centers must stay in America — but US grids can't handle the demand, and your bill may rise anyway.

2. Taxing the Builders

He proposes taxing companies that build abroad, forcing AI infrastructure back home. But what happens when the power isn't there?

3. The Grid Stops Here

Even if data centers stay, US power grids are already strained. Blackouts and rate hikes are on the table.

4. Your Bill, No Matter What

Energy costs get passed to consumers. Location won't shield your wallet from the AI boom.

5. Watch the Groundbreaking

Next time a data center breaks ground, check the grid. Does it make sense to pay more for AI if the lights go out?
